facts.fact: ANIP says births are declared and registered in the maternity at ten pilot public health facilities, launched 20 August 2025 at CHU-MEL Cotonou.
facts.system: Guichet Unique de declaration des Naissances

facts.fact: ANIP says the single-window registration ran as a pilot in ten public health facilities between August 2025 and February 2026, with arrondissement chiefs to be empowered to declare out-of-facility births before 31 December 2026.
facts.system: Guichet Unique de declaration des Naissances
